Property.name: Create Historic Events
Property.Description: "Create Historic Events" : Boolean to trigger whether historic events are created. Used in conjunction with send historic event settings and historic event targets. If this isn't checked the historic targets will not get any records at all and all targets would want to subscribe to the regular targets which receive all records of their type. This setting is to send help records to cerner for historical purposes so that doctors can get a full picture of patient lab histories on the new system.

Property.name: Send Standard Order Historic Events
Property.Description: "Send Standard Order Historic Events" : Boolean to trigger the actual sending of historic events. If this is checked then "Historic Standard Order Events Target" will receive both cerner and help records. If this is not checked then the "Historic Standard Order Events Target" will only receive cerner events. If "Create Historic Events" is unchecked this target would recieve no records at all.

Property.name: Send Micro Order Historic Events
Property.Description: "Send Micro Order Historic Events" : Boolean to trigger the actual sending of historic events. If this is checked then "Historic Micro Order Events Target" will receive both cerner and help records. If this is not checked then the "Historic Micro Order Events Target" will only receive cerner events. If "Create Historic Events" is unchecked this target would recieve no records at all. Micro orders are determined by OBR-24=MC.

Property.name: Send Standard Result Historic Events
Property.Description: "Send Standard Result Historic Events" : Boolean to trigger the actual sending of historic events. If this is checked then "Historic Standard Result Events Target" will receive both cerner and help records. If this is not checked then the "Historic Standard Result Events Target" will only receive cerner events. If "Create Historic Events" is unchecked this target would recieve no records at all.

Property.name: Send Bloodbank Result Historic Events
Property.Description: "Send Bloodbank Result Historic Events" : Boolean to trigger the actual sending of historic events. If this is checked then "Historic BloodBank Result Events Target" will receive both cerner and help records. If this is not checked then the "Historic BloodBank Result Events Target" will only receive cerner events. If "Create Historic Events" is unchecked this target would recieve no records at all. Bloodbank results are determined by OBR-24=B.

Property.name: Send Micro Result Historic Events
Property.Description: "Send Micro Result Historic Events" : Boolean to trigger the actual sending of historic events. If this is checked then "Historic Micro Result Events Target" will receive both cerner and help records. If this is not checked then the "Historic Micro Result Events Target" will only receive cerner events. If "Create Historic Events" is unchecked this target would recieve no records at all. Micro results are determined by OBR-24=MC.

Property.name: Historic Micro Order Events Target
Property.Description: "Historic Micro Order Events Target": Micro Orders targets that are sent in conjuction with "Create Historic Events" setting and "Send Micro Order Historic Events" setting. If both "Create Historic Events" and "Send Micro Order Historic Events" settings are checked then this target will recieve both cerner and help patient records with help records using H+EMPI as the PID-18 account number. If "Create Historic Events" is checked and "Send Micro Order Historic Events" is not checked then this target will recieve cerner patient records only. If "Create Historic Events" is unchecked then no other settings matter, this target will recieve no records.

Property.name: Micro Order Events Target
Property.Description: "Micro Order Events Target": Micro Orders targets. This target receives all micro orders reguardless of where they originated.

Property.name: Historic Standard Order Events Target
Property.Description: "Historic Standard Order Events Target": Standard Orders targets that are sent in conjuction with "Create Historic Events" setting and "Send Standard Order Historic Events" setting. If "Create Historic Events" is checked and "Send Standard Order Historic Events" is not checked then this target will recieve cerner patient records only. If "Create Historic Events" is unchecked then no other settings matter, this target will recieve no records.

Property.name: Standard Order Events Target
Property.Description: "Standard Order Events Target": Standard Orders targets. This target receives all standard orders reguardless of where they originated. This setting does not take historic settings above into account it always receives the records.
